However, the all-to-all global attention design leads to quadratic complexity and limits long-sequence inference; unconstrained cross-view interactions also can propagate unreliable evidence from occluded or visually similar but geometrically distant views. In this paper, We introduce a Masked Geometric Encoder (MGE), which promotes the learning of robust geometric representations under incomplete cross-view context. During training, MGE strategically drops frame tokens from global attention and distills from a pretrained full-context teacher model. This allows the model to learn an intrinsically richer per-frame representation while providing sufficient intermediate supervision to avoid performance degradation. Through extensive experiments, we show that MGE leads to much stronger performance under occlusion and doppelganger views while retaining high performance on standard benchmarks. Such a richer frame representation also leads to more effective token reduction during inference. To this end, we develop a novel Anchor-Guided Adaptive token merging technique that preserves representative anchor frames while jointly merging redundant tokens from the remaining views. Compared to other efficient inference approaches, we can achieve inference speedup while consistently maintaining higher reconstruction quality, particularly in limited-view settings.
tldr: 提出掩码几何编码器MGE，通过丢弃部分跨视角注意力并蒸馏全上下文教师，提升遮挡与相似视图下的3D重建鲁棒性和推理效率。
motivation: 现有3D基础模型依赖全对全局注意力，带来二次复杂度并限制长序列推理，且无约束跨视角交互会从遮挡或视觉相似但几何远离的视角传播不可靠证据。
method: 提出MGE，在训练时从全局注意力中策略性丢弃帧token，并从预训练全上下文教师模型蒸馏，以学习更丰富的单帧表征并借助中间监督避免性能退化；推理时采用锚点引导的自适应token合并，保留代表性锚帧并合并其余视角的冗余token。
result: 实验表明MGE在遮挡与doppelganger视图下性能显著更强，同时在标准基准上保持高性能；相比其他高效推理方法，可实现推理加速并持续保持更高重建质量，尤其在有限视角设置下，但摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: MGE通过不完整跨视角上下文学习鲁棒几何表征，提升3D基础模型在遮挡和易混淆视图下的鲁棒性，并借助锚点引导token合并实现高效推理，为长序列和有限视角场景提供更优精度-效率权衡。

title: GS-Pool: Object-Level Change Detection in 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Factories, museums and surveyors photograph the same space months apart and need to know which objects changed. When each visit is reconstructed with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), a direct comparison of the two reconstructions does not answer this. Training is stochastic, so two reconstructions of an unchanged space never coincide, and the second visit is often a quick re-scan with far fewer photographs. We propose GS-Pool, which takes two independently reconstructed Gaussian fields of the same space and returns the changed objects in each, together with their masks. SAM2 masks of each visit's photographs are lifted onto the Gaussians that render them and merged into an object pool, so every decision is taken once per object in 3D. We introduce a photographic carrier, the 3DGS training loss of each input reconstruction against the other visit's photographs, backpropagated to the Gaussians that rendered each pixel. We combine it with GS-Diff's geometry and colour terms and our distilled DINOv3 features. This evidence is compared with that of the objects present in both visits, which sets a change threshold for each scene. On PASLCD, GS-Pool reaches mIoU/F1 scores of 0.751/0.846 against 0.644/0.758 for GS-Diff, the strongest prior method, a gain of 17%/12%. Its mIoU is also 36%, 40% and 57% above that of O-SCD, PlenoCI and MV-3DCD, and it reaches 0.855 mIoU on CL-Splats, 33% above MV-3DCD. Each changed object is returned as a set of Gaussians with the evidence behind its decision, which an inspector can review in 3D.
tldr: GS-Pool 通过对象池与多源证据融合，实现独立3DGS重建间的对象级三维变化检测。
motivation: 工厂、博物馆和测绘人员常需比对相隔数月拍摄的同一空间，并找出发生变化的物体；但两次访问分别用3DGS重建后，直接比较无法回答该问题。原因是训练具有随机性，未变化空间的两次重建也不会重合，且第二次访问常为照片远少于首次的快速重扫。
method: GS-Pool 输入同一空间的两套独立重建高斯场，输出各次访问中的变化物体及其掩码。方法用SAM2分割每次访问照片，将掩码提升到渲染对应像素的高斯并合并为对象池，使决策按3D对象进行；同时引入摄影载体——将一套重建对另一访照片的3DGS训练损失反传至渲染各像素的高斯，并与GS-Diff几何/颜色项及蒸馏DINOv3特征融合，再与两访共有物体的证据比较以逐场景设定变化阈值。
result: 在PASLCD上，GS-Pool取得mIoU/F1 0.751/0.846，优于最强先前方法GS-Diff的0.644/0.758，提升17%/12%；其mIoU还分别比O-SCD、PlenoCI、MV-3DCD高36%、40%、57%。在CL-Splats上达到0.855 mIoU，比MV-3DCD高33%。
conclusion: GS-Pool 解决了独立3DGS重建因随机性与视角差异难以直接比较的问题，实现了对象级3D变化检测。每个变化物体以高斯集合及其决策证据返回，便于检查员在3D中复核，并在多个数据集上显著超越先前方法。

title: VGGT-Bridge: Beyond Sequential Pose Graphs via Coarse-Stride Skip Edges
abstract: Feed-forward visual geometry transformers such as VGGT reconstruct dense 3D structure from images in a single forward pass, simplifying multi-view 3D reconstruction. However, their quadratic attention complexity makes them difficult to scale to long sequences with thousands of frames. Chunk-and-align frameworks address this by splitting a long sequence into overlapping chunks and stitching their local reconstructions into a pose graph. Yet existing methods connect only sequentially adjacent chunks, so small per-frame errors accumulate along the chain into large-scale drift. To move beyond sequential edges, we propose VGGT-Bridge, which adds long-range skip edges that directly constrain non-adjacent chunks without retraining. By running VGGT on sparsely sampled coarse chunks, each coarse chunk bridges distant fine chunks into a single direct constraint. We further turn VGGT's first-frame scale bias into a drift correction by feeding selected coarse chunks in reverse, and a loop-aware policy keeps this reversal compatible with existing loop closures. VGGT-Bridge reduces ATE by 28.3% on KITTI Odometry, 18.8% on Virtual KITTI, and 10.0% on Waymo Open over the SwiftVGGT baseline, achieving the best performance among all chunk-and-align methods.
tldr: VGGT-Bridge通过粗步长跳跃边连接非相邻分块，无需重训练即可抑制长序列重建漂移。
motivation: 前馈视觉几何Transformer如VGGT能单次前向重建稠密3D结构，但二次注意力复杂度使其难以扩展到数千帧的长序列。现有分块对齐框架仅连接序列相邻块，逐帧小误差沿链累积形成大尺度漂移。
method: 提出VGGT-Bridge，在分块姿态图中加入长程跳跃边，直接约束非相邻分块且无需重训练。方法对稀疏采样的粗粒度分块运行VGGT，使每个粗分块将远处精细分块桥接为单一直接约束；并将VGGT首帧尺度偏置通过反向输入选定粗分块转化为漂移校正，同时用闭环感知策略保持与现有闭环兼容。
result: 相比SwiftVGGT基线，VGGT-Bridge在KITTI Odometry上ATE降低28.3%，在Virtual KITTI上降低18.8%，在Waymo Open上降低10.0%，在所有分块对齐方法中取得最佳性能。
conclusion: 结果表明，引入非顺序长程约束可有效缓解分块重建中的漂移累积，提升长序列视觉几何重建与里程计精度，并为扩展前馈几何Transformer到大规模场景提供无需重训练的实用方案。

title: MaRO-GS: Mask-Robust Object-Centric Gaussian Splatting from Inconsistent Multi-view Masks
abstract: We address the challenge of accurate 3D object reconstruction from multi-view images in Gaussian Splatting. Existing object-level 3DGS methods reconstruct the entire scene rather than directly optimizing the target object, even when only the target object is needed, which incurs substantial computational overhead. They also rely on 2D segmentation masks to associate Gaussians with objects, but these masks are often inconsistent across views. Such inconsistencies corrupt Gaussian optimization and produce incorrectly supervised Gaussians that degrade object reconstruction fidelity. To overcome these limitations, we propose MaRO-GS, a 3DGS framework that directly optimizes target-object Gaussians from object-masked multi-view images and remains robust to inconsistent supervision. For reliable supervision, mask-reliability view filtering excludes unreliable views. Object-supported Gaussian density control suppresses Gaussians irrelevant to the target object and prevents background densification, while Silhouette-aligned Object Loss maintains object-focused optimization. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that MaRO-GS improves PSNR, segmentation accuracy, and computational efficiency, with the largest PSNR gain of 2.05 dB on the small-object LERF-Mask dataset.
tldr: MaRO-GS通过掩码可靠性视图过滤、对象支持密度控制和轮廓对齐损失，从多视图掩码图像直接优化目标对象，鲁棒应对掩码不一致。
motivation: 现有对象级3DGS方法重建整个场景而非直接优化目标对象，计算开销大；且依赖跨视图不一致的2D分割掩码，这些不一致会破坏高斯优化并产生错误监督，降低对象重建保真度。
method: MaRO-GS直接优化目标对象高斯，并引入掩码可靠性视图过滤排除不可靠视图，对象支持高斯密度控制抑制无关高斯和背景致密化，以及轮廓对齐对象损失保持对象聚焦优化。
result: 在多个数据集上，MaRO-GS提升了PSNR、分割精度和计算效率，在LERF-Mask小物体数据集上PSNR最大提升2.05 dB。
conclusion: MaRO-GS实现了从多视图不一致掩码中鲁棒重建目标对象，提升了重建质量和效率，为对象级3DGS提供了有效解决方案。

title: Toward Reliable Infant Pose Estimation: A Training-Dynamics Approach to Noisy Annotation Detection
abstract: Spontaneous movement analysis in preterm infants relies increasingly on markerless pose estimation (PE) to derive clinically relevant motion biomarkers directly from video recordings. Training accurate infant PE models requires large sets of manually annotated keypoints, and human annotation is inherently prone to error. Noisy keypoints (i.e., keypoints mislocalized with respect to their true anatomical position) are especially problematic in this clinical setting, since they can propagate as artificial artifacts into the reconstructed joint trajectories. Building on the small-loss hypothesis and training-dynamics-based sample selection established in the noisy-label learning literature, we propose a novel framework for detecting noisy keypoint annotations. A hybrid convolutional-attention model is trained to predict the anatomical category of each keypoint from its spatial coordinates and local visual features; the resulting cross-entropy training dynamics are then used to derive per-keypoint descriptors, which are partitioned into clean and noisy subsets via unsupervised clustering. We validate the approach on NeoPose, a newly collected dataset of 65 hospitalized preterm infants, under two realistic noise scenarios (random positional perturbation and left-right swapping) across multiple noise levels. Results show that the proposed approach achieves an F1-score of up to 91.9% in noisy-keypoint detection. The framework further generalizes to the heterogeneous COCO benchmark, where filtering CE-detected noisy keypoints from the training set also yields measurable improvements (up to 7.4 AP points) in downstream pose estimation accuracy at moderate-to-high noise levels.
tldr: 基于训练动态和无监督聚类检测婴儿姿态估计中的噪声关键点标注，F1最高91.9%并提升下游AP。
motivation: 早产儿自发运动分析日益依赖无标记姿态估计，但训练准确模型需要大量人工标注关键点，而人工标注易出错。临床场景中错位关键点会作为伪影传播到重建关节轨迹，因此需要可靠检测噪声关键点标注。
method: 基于小损失假设和噪声标签学习中的训练动态样本选择，提出噪声关键点检测框架。方法训练混合卷积-注意力模型，从关键点空间坐标和局部视觉特征预测其解剖类别，再由交叉熵训练动态得到逐关键点描述子，并通过无监督聚类划分为干净与噪声子集。
result: 在包含65名住院早产儿的新数据集NeoPose上，针对随机位置扰动和左右交换两种现实噪声场景及多个噪声水平，噪声关键点检测F1最高达91.9%。在异构COCO基准上，过滤通过该方法检测出的噪声关键点后，下游姿态估计精度在中等至高噪声水平下最高提升7.4 AP。
conclusion: 该工作提出了一种基于训练动态的噪声关键点标注检测框架，可提升婴儿姿态估计数据质量并泛化到COCO等通用基准。其贡献在于减少临床运动生物标志物中的伪影传播，并为噪声关键点标注检测提供可扩展方案。

title: Casual Flash Lighting for Gaussian Splat Inverse Rendering
abstract: Recovering geometry, materials, and lighting from photographs is highly ambiguous when only static illumination is available. Active-lighting setups reduce the ambiguity but require dark rooms or specialized hardware. Instead, we synergize both static and flash lighting from casual indoor capture, with the flash on or off, each from independent viewpoints. The flash residual constrains albedo and the BRDF, while static lighting captures grazing-angle specular highlights that flash misses. With a 2DGS reconstruction framing, our key contribution is a GS-anchored diffuse field: a hash-encoded MLP is queried at the rasterized 2DGS depth. As it depends only on world position, it is view consistent in 3D and allows the flash residual to drive material decomposition instead of being absorbed by alpha-blending drift across views. At the same time, we render static lighting with deferred shading such that it can also supervise material decomposition. On five synthetic and three real indoor scenes, our method outperforms six recent baselines on diffuse color, albedo and roughness material parameters, and in relighting where PSNR improves by 4.17 dB over the next-best baseline.
tldr: 提出结合静态与闪光灯照明的高斯泼溅逆渲染方法，通过GS锚定漫反射场分解材质，重光照PSNR提升4.17dB。
motivation: 仅使用静态光照从照片中恢复几何、材质和光照存在高度歧义；主动光照设置虽能降低歧义，但需要暗室或专用硬件。本文旨在利用随意室内拍摄中同时存在的静态光照与闪光灯（开/关）来缓解这一歧义。
method: 基于2DGS重建框架，提出GS锚定的漫反射场：在光栅化的2DGS深度处查询哈希编码MLP，该场仅依赖世界坐标因而具有3D视角一致性，使闪光残差能驱动材质分解而非被跨视角alpha混合漂移吸收；同时用延迟着色渲染静态光照以监督材质分解。结合静态光照与闪光灯（独立视角）的互补信息：闪光残差约束反照率与BRDF，静态光照捕捉闪光缺失的掠射角高光。
result: 在5个合成和3个真实室内场景上，方法在漫反射颜色、反照率和粗糙度材质参数上优于6个近期基线，重光照PSNR比次优基线提升4.17 dB。
conclusion: 提出了一种结合静态与闪光灯照明的随意室内捕获逆渲染方法，通过GS锚定漫反射场和延迟着色解决了跨视角不一致问题，实现了更优的材质分解与重光照。该方法降低了主动光照逆渲染对专用硬件的依赖，推动了实用化的材质与光照估计。

title: Structural Foundations of Nonlinear Systems with Unknown Inputs: The UID-Induced Normal Form and Minimal-Sensing Structure-from-Motion
abstract: This paper establishes the first general structural solution to the problem of state estimation for nonlinear systems driven by unknown inputs. Building upon nonlinear unknown-input observability theory, we show that every such system admits a structurally equivalent representation, referred to as the UID-induced normal form. The proposed representation decomposes the information carried by the unknown inputs into two complementary components: unknown-input directions that are structurally decoupled from the observable dynamics and observable quantities that completely represent the unknown-input information affecting the observable dynamics. As a consequence, the UID-induced normal form provides a unified structural solution to unknown-input decoupling and unknown-input reconstruction, without requiring any model or stochastic assumption on the unknown inputs. The practical significance of the proposed framework is demonstrated through a previously unexplored minimal Structure-from-Motion configuration. The proposed representation enables recursive state estimation from only three point features and a single-axis gyroscope, allowing the recovery of the three-dimensional structure and camera motion up to an unknown global scale factor. Experiments on real-world data validate the proposed framework and demonstrate the feasibility of this minimal sensing configuration.
tldr: 提出未知输入诱导正规形，统一实现非线性系统未知输入解耦与重构，并用于仅三特征点加单轴陀螺仪的最小SfM。
motivation: 针对未知输入驱动的非线性系统，现有状态估计方法通常依赖未知输入模型或随机假设，缺乏通用的结构化解耦与重构框架。本文旨在建立首个一般性结构解，以在无模型假设下处理未知输入对可观测动态的影响。
method: 基于非线性未知输入可观性理论，证明任意此类系统可化为结构等价的UID诱导正规形，将未知输入信息分解为与可观测动态解耦的未知输入方向和完整表征可观测动态影响的可观测量。该表示无需对未知输入作模型或随机假设，即可统一实现未知输入解耦与重构，并应用于最小SfM配置。
result: 真实数据实验验证了该框架，表明仅需三个点特征和单轴陀螺仪即可进行递归状态估计，恢复三维结构与相机运动至多相差一个未知全局尺度。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 本文首次给出未知输入非线性系统状态估计的一般结构解，贡献在于UID诱导正规形及其对未知输入解耦与重构的统一处理，并展示了最小感知SfM的可行性。该框架为无需未知输入模型的估计问题与最小传感配置提供了理论基础和潜在应用方向。

title: Monocular Navigation Relative to Unknown Spacecraft Using a Transformer-Aided Kalman Filter
abstract: This work presents a novel learning-based pipeline for pose estimation of unknown spacecraft using only monocular images from a single servicer. The approach combines a transformer-based neural network with a Multi-State Constraint Kalman Filter (MSCKF) to estimate the pose (i.e., position and orientation of the target spacecraft relative to the camera) throughout rendezvous and proximity operations. Unlike existing vision-based methods that require prior knowledge of the target shape or inertia properties, rely on additional sensing modalities such as depth, lidar, or stereo, or only recover translation up to scale, the proposed pipeline generalizes to previously unseen spacecraft using a single monocular camera. The transformer network estimates the odometry, the change in pose between images up to scale, from SuperPoint features matched by LightGlue. The MSCKF uses these pseudo-measurements along with an orbit and attitude kinematics model to estimate the pose of the target. In particular, the relative orbit elements, the target's attitude with respect to the servicer's camera, and the associated angular velocity are estimated directly by the filter. Given the monocular approach and short distance to the target, the full observability of the range to the target is recovered via attitude maneuvers by the servicer. The method is trained and evaluated on a re-rendered high-resolution version of the SPE3R dataset, which includes synthetic images of 103 spacecraft. Eleven of these spacecraft are held out during training to evaluate the generalization to unseen targets. Monte Carlo simulations are then used to evaluate the navigation pipeline on rendered trajectories of the held out spacecraft. The results demonstrate that learned vision pipelines as a front-end for Kalman filters provide median errors of 3.7° in attitude and 2.2% of range in ROE when navigating about unknown targets.
tldr: 提出Transformer辅助MSCKF的单目导航方法，无需目标先验形状即可估计未知航天器相对位姿，实验显示姿态误差3.7°、ROE距离误差2.2%。
motivation: 现有基于视觉的航天器位姿估计方法通常需要目标形状或惯性先验，依赖深度、LiDAR或双目等额外传感器，或只能恢复尺度不确定的平移，难以在交会与近距离操作中泛化到未知目标。本研究旨在仅利用单目相机图像，实现未知航天器相对相机的位姿估计。
method: 提出一种Transformer辅助的MSCKF pipeline：Transformer网络从SuperPoint特征（经LightGlue匹配）中估计尺度不确定的帧间里程计，作为伪量测输入MSCKF，结合轨道与姿态运动学模型直接估计相对轨道要素、目标相对相机姿态及角速度；通过服务航天器姿态机动恢复距离可观测性。在重渲染的高分辨率SPE3R数据集（103个航天器，其中11个留出）上训练，并用蒙特卡洛仿真在留出目标轨迹上评估。
result: 在留出航天器的渲染轨迹上进行蒙特卡洛仿真，所提方法对未知目标导航的姿态中值误差为3.7°，相对轨道要素(ROE)距离中值误差为2.2%。
conclusion: 结果表明，学习视觉pipeline作为卡尔曼滤波前端可在未知航天器上实现较高精度导航，验证了仅用单目相机泛化到未见目标的可行性，为空间交会与近距离操作提供新思路。

title: RoboCap: A New Platform for Egocentric Robot Learning
abstract: Despite its promise for scaling robot learning, egocentric manipulation data is still scarce today. Collection at scale requires vertically integrating ergonomic hardware with centimeter-precise 3D algorithms, at a precision that has not been publicly demonstrated. To address this gap, we introduce RoboCap, a 250\,g six-camera dual-IMU hat designed for in-the-wild egocentric data capture, and the Grounded API, a suite of device-agnostic 3D algorithms tuned for RoboCap. In this report, we demonstrate how hardware, calibration, and 3D algorithms interact to achieve state-of-the-art performance on the public benchmarks: our SLAM across diverse settings and rigs, our depth estimation on egocentric settings, and our hand tracking when adapted to third-party devices.
tldr: 提出250g六摄像头双IMU帽子RoboCap与Grounded API，在SLAM、深度估计和手部追踪基准上达SOTA。
motivation: 为规模化机器人学习，第一视角操作数据仍稀缺；大规模采集需要集成符合人体工学的硬件与厘米级3D算法，而此前公开工作尚未证明能达到这一精度。RoboCap旨在填补该硬件与算法协同的空白。
method: 提出250g六摄像头双IMU帽子RoboCap，用于野外第一视角数据采集，并配套设备无关的Grounded API 3D算法套件，针对RoboCap调优。报告展示硬件、标定与3D算法如何交互以实现最优性能。
result: 在公开基准上取得SOTA：跨多种设置与设备的SLAM、第一视角场景深度估计，以及适配第三方设备的手部追踪。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作通过软硬件与标定协同，为第一视角机器人学习提供可规模化数据采集平台，并展示算法跨设备泛化能力，有望推动具身操作数据收集与学习研究。

title: MoonGS: High-quality Representation of the Lunar Surface via Gaussian Splatting Using Robust Depth Features from Image Pairs
abstract: High-quality 3D reconstruction of lunar terrain from sparse rover images is indispensable for autonomous lunar exploration, but remains challenging because viewpoint overlap is insufficient, surface textures are weak, and data volume is limited. We propose MoonGS, the first feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework tailored to lunar scenes. Given only two input images, MoonGS predicts pixel-aligned Gaussian primitives in a single forward pass and renders photorealistic novel views without any per-scene optimization. MoonGS (i) adopts an adaptable backbone design that seamlessly integrates advanced vision foundation models to extract robust depth features; (ii) integrates semantic priors in two manners: merging semantic cues with visual features to refine Gaussian parameter estimation, and adopting a semantic ranking loss that regularizes background depth; and (iii) employs an entropy-guided heuristic resampling strategy to augment sparse observations by selecting the most informative distant viewpoints with negligible overhead. Experiments on the LuSNAR benchmark and our synthetic weak-texture MoonBlender dataset show that MoonGS surpasses state-of-the-art feed-forward NeRF/3DGS baselines by +4.9 dB PSNR, +0.29 SSIM, and 40\% lower LPIPS while maintaining sub-second inference. Furthermore, we validate the broad applicability of our framework by demonstrating that it effectively leverages state-of-the-art backbones, including VGGT, to significantly boost performance. Qualitative evaluations on Chang'e mission imagery also show the best visual quality among compared methods, indicating robustness on real lunar data. The source code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/InRobots/MoonBlender.
tldr: 提出首个面向月面场景的前馈3DGS框架MoonGS，仅用两图实现高质量新视角合成。
motivation: 月面稀疏巡视器图像存在视角重叠不足、纹理弱和数据量有限等问题，高质量三维重建对自主月球探测至关重要，但现有方法难以稳定应对。
method: MoonGS在单次前向传播中预测像素对齐高斯基元，无需逐场景优化；采用可适配骨干融合视觉基础模型提取鲁棒深度特征，结合语义线索精炼高斯参数并引入语义排序损失正则化背景深度，还通过熵引导重采样选择信息量大的远视角以增强稀疏观测。
result: 在LuSNAR基准和弱纹理MoonBlender数据集上，MoonGS较SOTA前馈NeRF/3DGS基线提升+4.9 dB PSNR、+0.29 SSIM，LPIPS降低40%，并保持亚秒级推理；在嫦娥任务影像上视觉质量最佳，且验证了VGGT等先进骨干的通用增益。
conclusion: 研究表明MoonGS能有效提升稀疏月面图像的三维重建保真度与真实数据鲁棒性，并已开源代码与数据集以促进后续研究。

title: SteadySplats: Resampling of Low-Variance Gaussians for High-Fidelity Stochastic Rendering
abstract: Stochastic order-independent transparency enables efficient and elegant rendering of primitive-based radiance fields like 3D Gaussian Splatting models, but remains impractical due to the inherent visible noise in the output. We propose a principled approach to minimize high-frequency noise, addressing its sources at the representation and image synthesis level. During stochastic rendering, our history-based spatial resampling scheme drastically accelerates image convergence, while temporal importance resampling ensures coherence under camera movement. During training, a color regularizer implicitly reduces the variance along view rays in the 3DGS models. With these properties, our optimized, Vulkan-based renderer effectively mitigates output noise at low and high sample counts, achieving a substantial 13~dB PSNR increase in quality over previous stochastic methods at 1 sample per pixel and quickly converging to sorted 3DGS with an average L1 error of less than $10^{-4}$.
tldr: 通过空间/时间重采样和颜色正则化减少随机3DGS渲染噪声，1spp下PSNR提升13dB。
motivation: 随机顺序无关透明能高效渲染3D Gaussian Splatting等图元辐射场，但输出中固有的可见噪声使其难以实用。该工作旨在从表示与图像合成层面系统性降低高频噪声。
method: 提出SteadySplats：随机渲染时使用基于历史的空间重采样加速图像收敛，并用时间重要性重采样保证相机运动下的时间一致性；训练时引入颜色正则化，隐式降低3DGS模型沿视线的方差，并实现基于Vulkan的优化渲染器。
result: 在每像素1采样下，相较先前随机方法PSNR提升约13 dB；在低采样和高采样数下均能有效抑制噪声，并快速收敛至排序3DGS，平均L1误差小于1e-4。
conclusion: 该工作表明联合优化表示与图像合成可显著缓解随机顺序无关透明的噪声问题，使随机渲染质量接近排序3DGS，提升3DGS透明渲染的实用性。

title: Deep Prior Learning for Embodied Perception
abstract: Embodied systems need geometric perception that exploits available observations beyond images alone. Recent feed-forward 3D models incorporate geometric priors, including camera poses, intrinsics, and depth. However, handling noisy poses, preserving accurate priors, and recovering physical scale require more than simply accepting these inputs. We introduce \emph{Vision-Prior Geometry Grounded Transformer} (VPGGT), a VGGT-based framework that extends OmniVGGT for prior-aware embodied perception. We formulate sensor-motivated pose corruptions from ground-truth trajectories for training and introduce a parameter-free \emph{prior residual connection} (PRC) to mitigate \emph{prior dilution}, where predictions are less accurate than their supplied pose priors. Our noise formulation targets camera poses; supplied intrinsics and depth receive no additional corruption. We further introduce \emph{Metric Global Attention}, which conditions a global scale token on available pose and depth scales and predicts a shared metric scaling factor for the geometric outputs. Experiments across four datasets show that \emph{PRC} improves translation-direction accuracy and joint pose AUC over a matched training baseline when camera priors are provided for all views, under both exact and corrupted poses. These results support explicit prior access during refinement as a useful addition to feature-level conditioning.
tldr: 提出VPGGT，用PRC缓解先验稀释并用Metric Global Attention恢复统一尺度，提升噪声位姿下的具身几何感知。
motivation: 具身系统需要超越图像本身的几何感知，现有前馈3D模型虽引入相机位姿、内参与深度等先验，但在处理噪声位姿、保持准确先验以及恢复物理尺度方面仍不足。
method: 基于VGGT并扩展OmniVGGT提出VPGGT；利用真值轨迹生成传感器启发的位姿损坏进行训练，引入无参数先验残差连接PRC以缓解先验稀释，并提出Metric Global Attention，以可用位姿与深度尺度条件化全局尺度token，预测几何输出的共享度量缩放因子。
result: 在四个数据集上，当所有视角均提供相机先验时，无论位姿精确还是损坏，PRC相比匹配训练基线均提升平移方向精度与联合位姿AUC；摘要未提供具体数值。
conclusion: 结果表明，在细化阶段显式访问先验可作为特征级条件化的有效补充，凸显显式先验访问在具身几何感知中的价值，并有望增强噪声位姿与尺度恢复场景下的鲁棒性。

title: Have I Scene This Before? Spatially Grounded Conversational Memory for Complex Queries in Egocentric Assistants
abstract: Egocentric assistants must connect what users say with what they see across long interaction histories. We formalize this challenge as Spatially grounded Conversational Reasoning (SpaCR): cross-scene, recall-oriented, and counterfactual spatial queries that combine user-stated facts with geometric evidence. Direct vision-language models incur high inference costs and context limits as histories grow, while keyframe selection and retrieval can omit objects or evidence needed for complete recall. We propose Spatially grounded Conversational Memory (SpaC-MEM), an object-centric working memory that uses 3D reconstruction and segmentation to ground conversational information in persistent physical objects. It compresses multimodal histories while preserving spatial evidence and allowing object-specific facts to be updated through dialogue. We also introduce Ego-SpaCR, a benchmark comprising 620 ScanNet video sessions augmented with 95 task-oriented conversations and 3,100 evaluation queries. SpaC-MEM achieves the highest overall answer accuracy among the evaluated methods and improves object recall while requiring substantially fewer reference input tokens than native-video baselines. Removing 3D spatial information substantially degrades performance, highlighting the importance of preserving spatial and conversational evidence together.
tldr: 提出以物体为中心的SpaC-MEM，用3D重建与分割将对话记忆锚定到物理对象，在Ego-SpaCR基准上提升复杂空间查询准确率并减少输入token。
motivation: 第一人称助手需在长交互历史中连接用户言语与所见内容，但直接使用视觉语言模型推理成本高且受上下文长度限制，关键帧选择与检索又可能遗漏完整回忆所需的物体或证据。为此，论文形式化定义跨场景、面向回忆与反事实的空间查询任务SpaCR。
method: 提出SpaC-MEM，一种以物体为中心的工作记忆，利用3D重建与分割将对话信息锚定到持续存在的物理对象，压缩多模态历史同时保留空间证据，并支持通过对话更新对象级事实。同时构建Ego-SpaCR基准，包含620个ScanNet视频会话、95个任务导向对话和3100条评估查询。
result: SpaC-MEM在所有评估方法中取得最高总体答案准确率，提升物体召回率，且所需参考输入token显著少于原生视频基线。消融实验表明，移除3D空间信息会显著降低性能。
conclusion: 结果表明，联合保留空间与对话证据对第一人称助手的复杂回忆查询至关重要；SpaC-MEM为可扩展的空间锚定对话记忆提供了有效方案，Ego-SpaCR基准可推动后续研究。

title: Mobile-4DGS: Unified Static-Dynamic Real-time Mobile Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have achieved remarkable performance in novel view synthesis, yet deploying both static and dynamic Gaussian representations on resource-constrained mobile devices remains challenging due to heavy storage, redundant primitives, and costly per-frame computation. We present Mobile-4DGS, a unified lightweight framework for high-fidelity real-time static and dynamic Gaussian rendering on mobile platforms. For compact appearance modeling, we introduce a Monte Carlo Specular Energy Aggregator that compresses high-order radiance residuals into the first-order Spherical Harmonics (SH), together with an Attribute-Conditioned SH Enhancement module whose predicted offsets are pre-baked before inference. We further propose a Multi-View Alpha-Based Densification and Pruning strategy to suppress redundant primitives while maintaining multi-view consistency. For dynamic scenes, we develop a compact explicit 4D representation by constructing second-order Gaussian motion, learnable temporal support, and a binary static-dynamic partition, enabling continuous-time modeling without runtime deformation networks. Based on this partition, a Depth-Order Certificate selectively reuses previously committed depth orders to reduce re-projection, sorting, merging, and index-buffer updates during playback. Extensive experiments on static and dynamic scenes demonstrate that Mobile-4DGS substantially reduces storage and rendering overhead while maintaining competitive visual quality, enabling real-time 3D and 4D Gaussian Splatting on mobile devices. \textcolor{magenta}{\href{https://xiaobiaodu.github.io/mobile-4dgs-project/}{Code has been released: https://xiaobiaodu.github.io/mobile-4dgs-project/}}.
tldr: Mobile-4DGS 通过压缩外观、剪枝冗余基元与显式 4D 建模，实现移动端实时静态与动态高斯渲染。
motivation: 3DGS 在新视角合成上表现优异，但静态与动态高斯表示存在存储量大、基元冗余、逐帧计算开销高的问题，难以部署到资源受限的移动设备上；现有动态方法还依赖运行时变形网络，进一步加重端侧负担。
method: 提出统一轻量框架 Mobile-4DGS：用 Monte Carlo Specular Energy Aggregator 将高阶辐射残差压缩进一阶球谐，并用 Attribute-Conditioned SH Enhancement 在推理前预烘焙偏移；通过 Multi-View Alpha-Based Densification and Pruning 抑制冗余基元并保持多视角一致；动态部分构建二阶高斯运动、可学习时间支撑与二值静动态划分的紧凑显式 4D 表示，避免运行时变形网络，并利用 Depth-Order Certificate 复用已提交的深度顺序，减少重投影、排序、合并与索引缓冲更新。
result: 在静态与动态场景上的大量实验表明，Mobile-4DGS 在保持有竞争力视觉质量的同时显著降低存储与渲染开销，从而在移动设备上实现实时的 3D 与 4D 高斯泼溅渲染；摘要未给出具体量化指标，代码已开源。
conclusion: 该工作将静态与动态高斯渲染统一到单一轻量框架中，通过外观压缩、基元剪枝、显式 4D 表示与深度顺序复用等设计，为移动端实时 3D/4D 内容消费提供了可行方案，并已开源代码以推动后续研究与落地。

title: EMG-GPT: Predictive Pretraining on Residual-Quantized EMG Tokens for Hand Pose Estimation
abstract: Surface electromyography (sEMG) is a low-power, cost-effective biosignal for hand-pose estimation and gesture classification. In this work, we examine whether self-supervised pretraining on sEMG can yield transferable representations for continuous hand-pose estimation. We introduce EMG-GPT, a causal transformer-based model that operates on discrete sEMG representations from a frozen residual vector quantization (RVQ) tokenizer and learns temporal dynamics through depth-autoregressive future-code prediction. The model combines within-frame integration with causal temporal modeling while preserving the geometry of the pretrained codebook. EMG-GPT shows competitive results in both Regression and Tracking tasks, supporting EMG-only pretraining as a viable approach for learning transferable sEMG representations.
tldr: EMG-GPT利用RVQ离散肌电令牌进行因果预测预训练，在回归与追踪任务上取得竞争力结果。
motivation: sEMG是一种低功耗、低成本的生物信号，可用于手部姿态估计与手势分类；本文关注其自监督预训练能否产生可迁移的连续手部姿态估计表示。
method: 提出EMG-GPT，一种基于因果Transformer的模型，在冻结的残差向量量化(RVQ)分词器产生的离散sEMG表示上，通过深度自回归未来码预测学习时间动态。模型结合帧内整合与因果时序建模，并保持预训练码本的几何结构。
result: EMG-GPT在Regression和Tracking任务上均取得有竞争力的结果；摘要未提供具体量化指标或对比基线数值。
conclusion: 结果表明仅用EMG进行预训练可作为学习可迁移sEMG表示的有效途径，为连续手部姿态估计提供了新思路。

title: F$^2$ SLAM: Turning Feed-Forward Geometry into Persistent Factors for SLAM
abstract: Feed-forward 3D models provide strong multi-view geometric priors, while on- line simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) relies mainly on local mea- surements and can accumulate drift over long sequences. Existing attempts to combine the two typically treat feed-forward predictions as an external geomet- ric state that is aligned or fused with the online estimate after the fact, which keeps broader multi-view evidence outside the optimizer that refines the SLAM state. We present F2SLAM, which instead converts feed-forward geometry di- rectly into optimization-native target-weight measurements attached to a persis- tent dense factor graph. A high-frequency stream maintains local tracking con- straints and graph connectivity, while a low-frequency stream uses wider multi- view context to selectively refresh existing measurements after a state-consistency check. Both streams constrain the same poses, inverse depths, and optional cam- era intrinsics through a single dense bundle adjustment. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate consistently strong trajectory estimation and improved dense reconstruction in both calibrated and uncalibrated settings. Notably, the uncalibrated configuration reduces the average ATE RMSE from 0.030 m for the strongest feed-forward baseline to 0.002 m on the Replica dataset.
tldr: F2SLAM将前馈几何直接转为持久密集因子图中的优化原生测量，以低漂移在线SLAM提升轨迹与稠密重建。
motivation: 前馈三维模型能提供强多视图几何先验，但在线SLAM主要依赖局部测量，长序列中易累积漂移。现有结合方法多将前馈预测视为外部几何状态，事后对齐或融合，使更广的多视图证据游离于优化SLAM状态的优化器之外。
method: F2SLAM将前馈几何直接转换为挂在持久密集因子图上的优化原生目标权重测量。高频流维持局部跟踪约束与图连通性，低频流利用更广多视图上下文，在状态一致性检查后选择性刷新已有测量；两路流通过单次稠密光束法平差共同约束位姿、逆深度和可选相机内参。
result: 在多个基准上，F2SLAM在标定与未标定设置下均取得稳定较强的轨迹估计并改善稠密重建。未标定配置下，Replica数据集上平均ATE RMSE由最强前馈基线的0.030 m降至0.002 m。
conclusion: F2SLAM的贡献在于把前馈几何转化为优化器内的持久因子，而非外部对齐状态，从而统一在线SLAM与多视图先验。该方法显著降低漂移并提升稠密重建，尤其利于未标定场景，有望推动学习先验与经典SLAM优化的深度融合。

title: FreeLoc: Online Floorplan Localization via Diffusion-Aided Pose Refinement
abstract: Floorplans provide compact and widely available geometric maps for indoor localization, but existing high-performing floorplan-based methods still convert them into dense scene-specific offline databases, tying accuracy, storage, and runtime to the sampling resolution of the discretized pose space. We present FreeLoc, an online RGB-based floorplan localization framework that treats the floorplan as a directly queryable geometric map. FreeLoc introduces an efficient online geometric querying and diffusion-aided refinement scheme, which retrieves plausible pose anchors through on-the-fly floorplan ray querying and refines them into accurate continuous pose estimates. For sequential localization, FreeLoc develops an online likelihood construction strategy that bridges single-frame localization and probabilistic temporal fusion by constructing likelihoods from coarse-sampled candidates and refined pose hypotheses, enabling histogram-filter-based temporal fusion without offline databases. Experiments demonstrate real-time online inference and state-of-the-art performance in both single-frame and sequential localization, while real-world results validate practical deployability in indoor robotic localization scenarios.
tldr: FreeLoc将平面图作为可在线查询地图，用扩散精化位姿，免离线库实现实时室内定位。
motivation: 现有高性能基于平面图的室内定位方法通常将平面图转换为稠密的场景特定离线数据库，使精度、存储和运行时间受离散位姿空间采样分辨率制约。因此，需要一种无需离线数据库、能在线直接利用平面图进行RGB定位的方法。
method: FreeLoc将平面图视为可直接查询的几何地图，通过在线平面图射线查询检索可行位姿锚点，并利用扩散辅助精化获得连续而准确的位姿估计。对于序列定位，它从粗采样候选和精化位姿假设中在线构建似然，无需离线数据库即可实现直方图滤波时序融合。
result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标；实验表明FreeLoc可实时在线推理，在单帧和序列定位上均达到当前最优性能，并在真实场景中验证了室内机器人定位的可部署性。
conclusion: FreeLoc通过将平面图作为直接可查询几何地图并引入扩散辅助在线精化，消除了对离线数据库的依赖。其贡献在于实现无需离线数据库的实时在线平面图定位，并在真实室内机器人场景中展示可部署性，为可扩展的室内定位提供了新方案。

title: SteadySplats: Resampling of Low-Variance Gaussians for High-Fidelity Stochastic Rendering
abstract: Stochastic order-independent transparency enables efficient and elegant rendering of primitive-based radiance fields like 3D Gaussian Splatting models, but remains impractical due to the inherent visible noise in the output. We propose a principled approach to minimize high-frequency noise, addressing its sources at the representation and image synthesis level. During stochastic rendering, our history-based spatial resampling scheme drastically accelerates image convergence, while temporal importance resampling ensures coherence under camera movement. During training, a color regularizer implicitly reduces the variance along view rays in the 3DGS models. With these properties, our optimized, Vulkan-based renderer effectively mitigates output noise at low and high sample counts, achieving a substantial 13~dB PSNR increase in quality over previous stochastic methods at 1 sample per pixel and quickly converging to sorted 3DGS with an average L1 error of less than $10^{-4}$.
tldr: 提出SteadySplats，通过重采样与颜色正则化降低随机渲染噪声，1spp下PSNR提升13dB。
motivation: 随机顺序无关透明度能高效渲染3D Gaussian Splatting等基元辐射场，但输出存在明显可见噪声，导致其难以实用。该工作旨在从表示与图像合成层面抑制高频噪声源。
method: 训练阶段引入颜色正则化，隐式降低3DGS模型沿视射线的方差；随机渲染阶段采用基于历史的空间重采样加速图像收敛，并用时间重要性重采样保证相机运动下的时序一致性，最终实现基于Vulkan的优化渲染器。
result: 在1 sample per pixel下，该方法相比先前随机方法取得约13 dB的PSNR提升，并在低与高采样数下均有效抑制输出噪声；同时快速收敛到排序3DGS结果，平均L1误差小于1e-4。
conclusion: 该方法从表示与合成两端降低随机渲染噪声，使随机顺序无关透明度对3DGS高保真渲染更实用。其贡献包括低方差高斯重采样策略、颜色正则化与Vulkan渲染器，有望推动高效透明渲染和实时辐射场应用。

title: WiSPER: Pose-Supervised Predictive and Residual Flow Refinement For Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimation With WiFi CSI
abstract: Multi-person 3D pose estimation with WiFi channel state information (CSI) is challenging because reflections from different people overlap without directly identifying individual joints. Existing masked embedding objectives capture wireless relationships without explicit pose supervision, while structured decoders can retain coordinate errors. We propose WiSPER, a two-stage framework combining pose-aware predictive pretraining with conditional residual flow refinement. Pose-Aware Masked Embedding Learning (PAMEL) couples masked latent prediction with auxiliary pose-set supervision on the same CSI context, guiding the encoder toward joint localization from partial observations. Residual Flow refinement with Transformer (ReFT) generates a set of pose candidates to accommodate a variable number of people and refines each candidate through a conditional flow guided by its coarse coordinates and per-joint decoder features. Both stages use paired CSI and pose annotations during training, while inference requires only CSI. Experiments on the PiW3D dataset show that WiSPER achieves an overall mean per-joint position error of 63.72 mm, a 40.0% reduction relative to WiFi-JEPA. For experiments with two and three people, WiSPER reduces MPJPE by 42.1% and 38.1%, respectively. Pose-supervised pretraining configurations obtain lower errors than CSI-only JEPA, and enabling the trained residual refiner reduces overall MPJPE by 13.8-15.6% across the evaluated configurations.
tldr: WiSPER 用姿态监督预训练与条件残差流细化，实现仅靠 WiFi CSI 的多人体 3D 姿态估计，MPJPE 降低约 40%。
motivation: 多人体 WiFi CSI 3D 姿态估计中，不同人的反射信号相互叠加且无法直接识别个体关节；现有掩码嵌入目标缺乏显式姿态监督，结构化解码器仍会保留坐标误差。
method: 提出两阶段框架 WiSPER：PAMEL 在同一 CSI 上下文上耦合掩码隐变量预测与辅助姿态集监督，引导编码器从部分观测中定位关节；ReFT 生成姿态候选集以适配可变人数，并基于粗坐标与逐关节解码器特征通过条件流细化每个候选。训练使用配对 CSI 与姿态标注，推理仅需 CSI。
result: 在 PiW3D 数据集上，WiSPER 总体平均每关节位置误差为 63.72 mm，相对 WiFi-JEPA 降低 40.0%；两人和三人实验中 MPJPE 分别降低 42.1% 和 38.1%；姿态监督预训练配置误差低于仅 CSI 的 JEPA；启用训练后的残差细化器使总体 MPJPE 在各配置下降低 13.8–15.6%。
conclusion: 结果表明，姿态监督预训练与条件残差流细化能显著提升 WiFi CSI 多人体 3D 姿态估计精度，且推理阶段仅依赖 CSI，为无视觉多人姿态感知提供了可行方案。

title: Probabilistic Pedestrian Forecasts from a Handheld Phone: World-Frame Heat Maps, Visual-Inertial Height Drift, and Evaluation without Ground Truth
abstract: A pedestrian with a phone could be shown where nearby people will be in the next few seconds, if the forecast stays on the ground while the phone moves, is calibrated, and needs only a monocular camera and visual-inertial odometry (VIO). We build and evaluate such a system. People are detected, lifted onto the floor by ray-plane intersection, tracked in a gravity-aligned metric frame, and forecast as per-step probability maps by a small U-Net trained with a negative log-likelihood (NLL) loss on bird's-eye (SDD) and first-person (EgoTraj-Bench) trajectories. On handheld ADVIO recordings, vertical VIO drift and the user's own changes of level silently rescale monocular ground positions (by 87% within 90 s on one clip; on another, all tracks are lost for the last 31% of the clip); keeping the camera's height above the floor constant under a low-pass-filtered altitude avoids this, though it lags on escalators. On the SDD and EgoTraj-Bench test splits, the final forecaster lowers the NLL at 4.8 s by 1.51 and 1.37 nats relative to a fitted constant-velocity Gaussian. Lacking ground truth for people in handheld video, we score forecasts against the tracker's own later raw measurements. In an internally pre-registered evaluation on seven held-out clips, the final forecaster's NLL is lower than the benchmark-fitted baseline's at 1.2, 2.4 and 4.8 s (by 0.17, 0.23 and 0.47 nats; 95% intervals over people exclude zero), but by less than half as much as on the development clips. Exploratory analyses cut both ways: resampling clips instead of people widens the intervals to include zero at 1.2 and 2.4 s, and once both forecasters are recalibrated on the development clips the network is significantly better only at 1.2 s; but two clips run with ADVIO's reference poses favour the network much more when re-run with the phone's own poses. We discuss what such self-consistency scores can and cannot show.
tldr: 提出手持手机单目VIO的行人概率预测系统，在重力对齐世界系输出热图，并评估无真值自一致性。
motivation: 手持手机用户希望获知附近行人未来几秒的位置，但预测需在手机移动时保持在地面坐标系、经过校准，且仅依赖单目相机与视觉惯性里程计（VIO）。同时，手持视频中行人缺少真值，给系统评估带来核心困难。
method: 系统检测行人后通过射线-平面相交将其投影到地面，在重力对齐的度量坐标系中跟踪，并用小型U-Net以负对数似然（NLL）损失训练输出逐步概率热图，数据来自鸟瞰SDD和第一人称EgoTraj-Bench。为抑制VIO高度漂移，方法对高度低通滤波并保持相机离地高度恒定，但扶梯等场景会滞后。
result: 在SDD和EgoTraj-Bench测试集上，最终预测器在4.8秒时将NLL相对拟合的恒速高斯基线分别降低1.51和1.37 nats。手持ADVIO上，垂直VIO漂移和用户楼层变化会静默缩放单目地面位置，某片段90秒内缩放达87%，另一片段最后31%轨迹全丢；七个留出片段的预注册评估中，最终预测器在1.2、2.4和4.8秒的NLL分别低0.17、0.23和0.47 nats，按人聚合的95%区间排除零，但提升不足开发片段的一半。探索性分析显示按片段重采样会使1.2和2.4秒区间包含零，双预测器在开发片段重校准后网络仅在1.2秒显著更优。
conclusion: 论文贡献了一套可在手持手机上运行、输出世界系概率热图的行人预测系统，并揭示VIO高度漂移对单目地面定位的严重影响及低通高度稳定的缓解作用。其无真值自一致性评估协议有参考价值，但重采样方式、校准和位姿来源会显著改变结论，因此此类分数需谨慎解读。

title: GS-Codec: A Gaussian-Splatting Bottleneck for Neural Audio Coding
abstract: Neural audio codecs compress waveforms into compact discrete tokens that underpin speech language models, real-time communication, and large-scale audio storage. Almost every dominant design, including residual vector quantization, finite scalar quantization, and single-codebook variants, follows the VQ-VAE template by partitioning the encoder latent through a learned codebook or a fixed scalar grid. We ask whether this partition is necessary. We introduce GS-Codec, a neural speech codec whose bottleneck is a parametric signal decomposition rather than a quantizer. We adapt Gaussian splatting from 3D scene reconstruction to one-dimensional latents. An inner optimization loop fits each encoder segment as a weighted sum of 1D Gaussian primitives. The decoder then reconstructs the waveform from the rendered sum. To avoid the cost of this iterative inner loop at inference time, we additionally train a lightweight GS Predictor Net that regresses the primitive parameters in a single forward pass. The encoder and decoder are trained end-to-end through the inner loop, with no quantizer anywhere in the training pipeline: the bottleneck is the decomposition itself, and scalar quantization is applied only post-training to the fitted parameters. Rather than relying on discrete codebook stages for bitrate control, our representation exposes a fine-grained rate-quality tradeoff: a single trained checkpoint supports post-training bitrate control by varying the number of primitives and the per-parameter bit depth, with no retraining required. GS-Codec matches or exceeds well-established open-source codecs such as EnCodec and DAC on speaker similarity (SIM), intelligibility (STOI), and perceptual quality (UTMOS) at comparable bitrates, while achieving comparable semantic performance (WER). Code and audio samples are available at https://ronaluf.github.io/gs-codec/
tldr: GS-Codec 用 1D 高斯泼溅分解替代量化器作为神经语音编码瓶颈，支持事后码率控制并匹配 EnCodec/DAC。
motivation: 主流神经音频编解码器几乎都沿用 VQ-VAE 模板，通过学习码本或固定标量网格划分编码器隐变量。本文质疑这种离散划分是否必要，并探索以参数化信号分解作为编码瓶颈。
method: GS-Codec 将 3D 高斯泼溅适配到一维隐变量：内层优化把每个编码器片段拟合为 1D 高斯基元加权和，解码器从渲染和重建波形；同时训练轻量 GS Predictor Net 单次前向回归基元参数以规避推理时迭代。编码器与解码器经内循环端到端训练，训练管线中无量化器，瓶颈即分解本身；仅在训练后对拟合参数做标量量化，并通过调节基元数量和每参比特深度实现无需重训的细粒度码率控制。
result: 在可比码率下，GS-Codec 在说话人相似度 SIM、可懂度 STOI 和感知质量 UTMOS 上匹配或超过 EnCodec、DAC 等开源编解码器，同时语义性能 WER 相当。
conclusion: 该工作证明无需码本或量化器瓶颈，参数化高斯分解也可作为有效的神经音频编码瓶颈，并使单一训练检查点支持事后码率控制，对语音语言模型、实时通信和大规模音频存储具有潜在影响。

title: Sparse-View 4D Gaussian Splatting via Spatiotemporal Priors and Generative Assistance
abstract: We present a 4D Gaussian Splatting framework for the Sparse-View Track of the SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Volumetric Video Challenge, which requires dynamic scene reconstruction from only six cameras with wide baselines. To achieve robust dynamic reconstruction under such sparse views, our framework integrates three components. (1) Region-adaptive spatial priors: We use foreground masks to guide Gaussian initialization and mask voting to control densification separately for the dynamic foreground and static background. Background geometry is regularized using monocular depth aligned to metric scale. (2) Motion-consistent temporal priors: We provide supervision at intermediate times through frame interpolation and constrain projected Gaussian motion with estimated optical flow. (3) Generative assistance: We place virtual cameras in the widest angular gaps and restore their rendered images using a diffusion-based model conditioned on camera poses. The restored images are iteratively incorporated into training as pseudo-supervision. On the validation set, our framework improves full-frame PSNR from 25.60 dB for the baseline to 29.75 dB. On the official test benchmark, it achieves 30.04 dB full-frame PSNR and 27.88 dB foreground PSNR, ranking first overall in the Sparse-View Track.
tldr: 提出融合区域自适应空间先验、运动一致时间先验与扩散生成辅助的稀疏视角4D高斯泼溅框架。
motivation: 针对SIGGRAPH Asia 2026体视频挑战赛稀疏视角赛道，仅用六台大基线相机重建动态场景时，现有4D高斯泼溅因视角稀疏易出现初始化差、几何与运动监督不足等问题；旨在实现鲁棒的动态场景重建。
method: 框架集成三部分：(1)区域自适应空间先验，利用前景掩码引导高斯初始化，并通过掩码投票分别控制动态前景与静态背景的致密化，背景几何用度量尺度对齐的单目深度正则；(2)运动一致时间先验，通过帧插值在中间时刻提供监督，并用估计光流约束投影高斯的运动；(3)生成辅助，在最大角度间隙放置虚拟相机，用相机位姿条件扩散模型恢复渲染图像并迭代作为伪监督加入训练。
result: 验证集上全帧PSNR从基线25.60 dB提升至29.75 dB；官方测试基准上取得30.04 dB全帧PSNR和27.88 dB前景PSNR，在稀疏视角赛道总排名第一。
conclusion: 结果表明，结合时空先验与扩散生成伪监督能有效缓解六相机宽基线下的稀疏视角动态重建难题，提升重建保真度，并为体视频稀疏视角赛道提供了领先方案。

title: LoCoSplat: Real-Time Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Minimal 3D Reasoning
abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) increasingly aggregates multi-view evidence with heavy learned 3D networks. We propose LoCoSplat (Local-Context Splatting), motivated by the observation that a Gaussian is a local primitive: once depth is predicted, what the 3D stage must add (scale, rotation, opacity) depends on the point cloud around each anchor, and a fixed local average of that neighbourhood is enough to supply it, no heavy network required. LoCoSplat realises exactly this average: it splats a 16-d linear projection of the point features into a fine and a coarse grid and reads both back at each anchor with a 0.14M-parameter pointwise MLP; with no learned 3D network and no dynamic sparse computation, its whole encoder runs as one fp16 CUDA graph. On RealEstate10K, LoCoSplat outperforms every prior feed-forward method on PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS at 6, 12, and 24 views, with a margin that widens as views densify (+3.3 PSNR over VolSplat, the prior voxel-aligned state of the art, at 24 views) and grows further under zero-shot transfer to ACID and fine-tuning on ScanNet. It reconstructs a 6-view scene in 33 ms on one NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU, the fastest of seven feed-forward methods and $4.2\times$ faster than the previous state of the art, trains $2.7\times$ faster ($5.9\times$ at 24 views), and uses $6.7\times$ less inference memory.
tldr: LoCoSplat 用局部点云平均替代重型3D网络，实现实时前馈3DGS并提升多视图重建质量。
motivation: 前馈3DGS通常依赖重型学习3D网络聚合多视图证据，计算和内存开销大。该工作观察到高斯是局部基元：一旦预测深度，尺度、旋转和不透明度等属性可由每个锚点周围的局部点云统计量充分推断，无需复杂3D网络。
method: LoCoSplat将点特征的16维线性投影splat到细粒度和粗粒度网格，并在每个锚点读回，经仅0.14M参数的逐点MLP输出高斯属性。它不使用学习3D网络和动态稀疏计算，整个编码器可作为一个fp16 CUDA图运行。
result: 在RealEstate10K的6、12、24视图设置下，LoCoSplat在PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS上均超越所有前馈方法，24视图比VolSplat高3.3 PSNR；零样本迁移到ACID和微调ScanNet也进一步提升。单张RTX PRO 6000上重建6视图场景仅需33 ms，比此前SOTA快4.2倍，训练快2.7倍（24视图快5.9倍），推理内存少6.7倍。
conclusion: 研究表明无需重型3D网络即可实现高质量、实时的前馈3DGS重建，显著降低训练与推理成本，并为可扩展的新视角合成提供简单高效的新范式。

title: A differentiable Lagrangian-coupled 3D Gaussian Splatting-SPH model for forward simulation and inverse analysis in solid mechanics
abstract: Recent advances in generative world models have increased interest in digital models that reproduce both the appearance of real objects and their response to physical interaction. Three-dimensional reconstruction techniques, including 3D Gaussian Splatting, capture detailed surface geometry and appearance from images and videos. However, extending these representations beyond plausible animation to mechanically interpretable models for constitutive behavior, boundary conditions, and inverse parameter identification remains less explored. In this work, a differentiable Lagrangian-coupled 3DGS-smoothed particle hydrodynamics (SPH) model is proposed for forward simulation and inverse analysis of deformable solids. The observed object is first reconstructed from multi-view calibrated visual dataset as a 3DGS rendering model. An envelope-based procedure then generates an independent SPH support for the solid-mechanics model, avoiding the direct use of rendering primitives as mechanical particles. A reference-configuration Lagrangian transfer maps SPH deformation to Gaussian positions and covariances, thereby coupling the physical model and the image observation model while preserving a differentiable computational path. The SPH formulation supports linear elastic, hyperelastic, and Kelvin--Voigt viscoelastic responses, together with fixed, free, and Robin-type boundary conditions. Numerical studies validate the SPH response against finite-element results, assess accuracy and efficiency against a conventional model using Gaussian centers as surface SPH particles, and demonstrate forward simulations on beam, bridge, and liver-shaped examples. Inverse analyses further estimate constitutive and boundary parameters from rendered deformation observations, including noisy cases, demonstrating the feasibility of the proposed model for mechanics-based parameter identification from image data.
tldr: 提出可微拉格朗日耦合3DGS-SPH模型，实现可变形固体的正向仿真与逆参数辨识。
motivation: 3DGS能从图像/视频重建高保真表面几何与外观，但将其扩展到可力学解释的本构行为、边界条件建模和逆参数辨识仍研究不足；本文旨在填补从视觉重建到固体力学正向仿真与逆分析的空白。
method: 方法先从多视角标定视觉数据重建3DGS渲染模型，再用包络流程生成独立SPH支撑，避免直接将渲染基元作为力学粒子；通过参考构型拉格朗日传递将SPH变形映射到高斯位置与协方差，从而在保持可微计算路径下耦合物理与图像观测模型。SPH框架支持线弹性、超弹性和Kelvin–Voigt黏弹性，以及固定、自由和Robin型边界条件。
result: 数值研究将SPH响应与有限元结果对比验证，并评估其相对以高斯中心作为表面SPH粒子的常规模型的精度与效率；在梁、桥和肝脏形状算例上完成正向仿真。逆分析从渲染变形观测中估计本构与边界参数，含噪声情形也得到验证。
conclusion: 该工作展示了从图像数据开展基于力学的参数辨识的可行性，为可微视觉-物理耦合仿真和数字孪生式建模提供了新途径。

title: Synthetic-to-Real ViT-Based Pose Estimation of a Noncooperative UAV
abstract: Remote pose estimation of noncooperative Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) from imagery is critical, as they cannot be influenced or instrumented in advance. Deep-learning-based approaches offer a promising solution; however, their development is constrained by the cost and difficulty of acquiring large-scale real-world datasets with accurate pose labels. Synthetic imagery provides an alternative, but models trained on synthetic data must overcome the synthetic-to-real domain gap to generalize to real-world imagery. This work investigates the inherent synthetic-to-real generalization capability of a Vision Transformer (ViT)-based model for monocular UAV pose estimation. The proposed approach employs a self-supervised DINOv2 backbone and is trained exclusively on labeled synthetic imagery while being evaluated on labeled real-world imagery. Pose ambiguity-aware strategies are incorporated during training and inference to address ambiguities arising from the projection of a three-dimensional target onto a two-dimensional image plane and from target symmetries. An $α$-$β$ filter is further integrated during inference to improve pose estimations. To assess the model under operational requirements, it is evaluated in terms of Mean Angular Error (MAE) and inference time, both before and after filtering, using a real-world dataset containing 77,077 labeled UAV images. Before filtering, the model achieves an MAE of $19.18^{\circ}$ and an inference time of $13.25$ ms, whereas after filtering, these values are $8.74^{\circ}$ and $13.42$ ms, respectively.
tldr: 提出基于DINOv2 ViT的无人机单目位姿估计，仅用合成数据训练并借助歧义处理与α-β滤波提升真实域泛化。
motivation: 非合作无人机无法预先安装传感器或施加影响，因此基于图像的远程位姿估计至关重要；但深度学习方法受限于大规模真实标注位姿数据获取成本高、难度大，合成数据虽可替代却面临合成到真实的域差距。
method: 该方法采用自监督DINOv2作为ViT主干，仅在带标签合成图像上训练，并在真实图像上评估；训练和推理中引入位姿歧义感知策略，以处理三维目标投影到二维平面及目标对称性带来的歧义，并在推理阶段加入α-β滤波器。
result: 在包含77,077张带标注无人机图像的真实数据集上评估，滤波前MAE为19.18°、推理时间13.25 ms；滤波后MAE降至8.74°、推理时间13.42 ms。
conclusion: 研究表明ViT模型结合歧义感知与滤波策略能在仅用合成数据训练的条件下有效泛化到真实无人机位姿估计，滤波显著降低角度误差且几乎不增加推理耗时，为非合作无人机远程位姿估计提供了可行方案。

title: Sparse-GS2Mesh: 3D Gaussian Splatting Guided by Novel Stereo Views and 2DGS for Sparse View Surface Reconstruction}
abstract: Surface reconstruction under sparse-view settings remains challenging due to limited geometric cues. Volume rendering methods based on signed distance functions often produce over-smoothed surfaces, while 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), though time-efficient, suffers from incomplete geometry due to the lack of reliable depth supervision and the limitation of being optimized only from given input views. In this paper, we present Sparse-GS2Mesh, a stereo-aware framework for surface reconstruction from sparse views. While 3DGS and stereo matching have been leveraged for surface reconstruction under dense view settings, we extend them to operate effectively under sparse view conditions by first initializing 3DGS using epipolar depth priors to mitigate the 3DGS overfitting problem, followed by our three key components: (I) adaptive baseline selection, (II) fine-tuning with a stereo matching network, and (III) 2D/3D co-regularized fine-tuning. Given a warmed-up 3DGS initialized with epipolar depth, the adaptive baseline selection automatically determines a baseline to synthesize for each sparse view. We then fine-tune 3DGS by backpropagating depth-refining gradients from the stereo matching network, effectively specializing the 3DGS for stereo matching. The 2D/3D co-regularization further helps obtain stable reconstruction, addressing weak geometric cues in close stereo views. Sparse-GS2Mesh achieves a 15\% improvement over state-of-the-art methods in little-overlap settings and comparable results in large-overlap settings. Codes will be publicly available.
tldr: 提出Sparse-GS2Mesh，以极线深度初始化3DGS，并结合自适应基线和立体匹配微调实现稀疏视图表面重建。
motivation: 稀疏视图下几何线索有限，SDF体积渲染常产生过度平滑表面，而3DGS虽高效却因缺乏可靠深度监督且仅从输入视图优化，导致几何不完整。
method: Sparse-GS2Mesh先用极线深度先验初始化3DGS以缓解过拟合，再利用自适应基线选择为每个稀疏视图合成新立体视图，并通过立体匹配网络回传深度细化梯度及2D/3D协同正则对3DGS进行微调。
result: 在little-overlap设置下，该方法较当前最优方法提升约15%；在large-overlap设置下取得与最优方法相当的结果，代码将公开。
conclusion: 该方法将3DGS与立体匹配有效扩展到稀疏视图表面重建，通过极线深度初始化与协同微调提升了几何完整性和稳定性，为低重叠稀疏视图重建提供了新思路。

title: CellSplat4D: PSF-Aware 4D Gaussian Splatting for Sparse Robotic Live-Cell Imaging
abstract: A robotic microscope watching living cells cannot afford to look as often as it would like. Every volume it acquires costs photons the specimen does not get back, and time owed to other wells. What such a platform exists to produce is a record of individual cells through time: which cell is which from one volume to the next, and which cell divided into which two. Sampling sparsely breaks that record exactly where it matters, and the fault lies in the acquisition schedule rather than in the analysis software. We fill the gaps by reconstructing them, fitting a 4D Gaussian model to whatever volumes the hardware could afford. The model is a cloud of light-emitting blobs, each carrying a position, a shape and a lifetime. Being continuous in time, it renders any missing volume on demand, decoupling how often the robot analyses from how often it can afford to look. The microscope's point-spread function is measured from the data rather than inherited from acquisition metadata or left to the optimizer, because metadata inflates it and the optimizer cannot recover it at all: a wider blur around a smaller blob fits the images equally well. Each blob's lifetime is stored in frames rather than as a fraction of the recording, so that it denotes a fixed duration on any sequence. Unmeasured timesteps are supervised at coarse scale by a 3D U-Net that predicts the intermediate volume directly and estimates no motion field, since a dividing cell becomes two and no motion describes that. On two Cell Tracking Challenge sequences, a C. elegans embryo and a Chinese Hamster Ovarian (CHO), with fidelity scored per cell nucleus, our reconstruction holds the highest nucleus fidelity at every distance from an acquired frame, has the flattest decay across the gap, and best recovers focal planes it was never shown with graceful degradation across the gap.
tldr: 提出PSF感知4D高斯泼溅，通过重建缺失体积提升稀疏活细胞成像的细胞核保真度。
motivation: 机器人显微镜在活细胞成像中受光子预算和时间限制只能稀疏采样，导致跨体积的细胞对应关系和分裂记录在关键处断裂，且问题源于采集计划而非分析软件。目标是在不增加采集负担的前提下补全缺失体积，维持单细胞时序记录。
method: 将已采集的稀疏体积拟合为连续时间的4D高斯点云，每个光斑具有位置、形状和以帧存储的寿命，可按需渲染缺失体积以解耦分析频率与采集频率。PSF从数据中测量而非继承元数据或交由优化器，避免元数据高估模糊及优化器的模糊核-光斑尺寸歧义。未测时间步由不估计运动场的3D U-Net在粗尺度直接预测中间体积，以适应细胞分裂等无运动对应的事件。
result: 在Cell Tracking Challenge的两个序列（C. elegans胚胎和CHO）上按细胞核保真度评估，本方法在距任意已采集帧处均取得最高细胞核保真度，跨间隙衰减最平缓，并最好地恢复未观测焦平面，且跨间隙性能平滑退化。
conclusion: 该工作提出PSF感知的4D高斯泼溅框架，用重建补全稀疏机器人活细胞成像的时序缺口，为无运动场建模细胞分裂和减少光毒性提供了可行路径。

title: Less Decoder is More Encoder: Geometric Representation Learning from Novel View Synthesis
abstract: This paper examines the role of Novel View Synthesis (NVS) in geometric representation learning. In principle, NVS should reason about 3D scene structure, thereby enabling transferable multi-view geometric representations. Yet, existing encoder-based NVS methods yield poor representations. This is not because of a lack of supervisory signal, but rather due to inconspicuous architectural choices: \textit{spatially expressive decoders} that dilute representational capabilities of the scene encoder, and \textit{low-level pixel-space targets} that hinder feature learning. We present SNAP, a self-supervised encoder-decoder transformer that addresses both through a pose-conditioned local decoder and a latent-space reconstruction objective. SNAP is task agnostic, and we show that it is competitive with special-purpose geometry-supervised methods. SNAP also performs competitively against self-supervised representations across five tasks: visual localization, pose estimation, point correspondence, depth estimation, and robot manipulation. Remarkably, SNAP's patch features exhibit emergent viewpoint invariance that approaches heavily supervised models despite lower compute and data budgets. Under camera shifts where standard 2D representations collapse, SNAP degrades more gracefully, revealing that restricting decoder expressivity actively prevents the suppression of transferable geometric structure. https://snap-nvs.github.io
tldr: SNAP通过简化解码器并在潜空间重建，从新视角合成中学习可迁移的几何表征。
motivation: 现有基于编码器的新视角合成方法学到的几何表征较差，原因并非缺乏监督信号，而是空间表达能力过强的解码器稀释了场景编码器，以及低层像素空间目标阻碍了特征学习。
method: 提出SNAP，一种自监督编码器-解码器Transformer，采用姿态条件局部解码器和潜空间重建目标，并保持任务无关性。
result: SNAP与专用几何监督方法具有竞争力，并在视觉定位、姿态估计、点对应、深度估计和机器人操作五类任务上媲美自监督表征。其patch特征在更低计算与数据预算下展现出接近重度监督模型的视角不变性，在相机变化下比标准2D表征退化更平缓。
conclusion: 限制解码器表达能力可防止可迁移几何结构被抑制，实现“更少解码器、更多编码器”的表征学习；SNAP为从新视角合成中学习通用几何表征提供了有效路线。

title: ManifoldSplat: Language-Guided Semantic Shape Editing of 3D Gaussian Head Avatars
abstract: High-fidelity 3D head avatars have reached near-photorealistic quality. While recent methods enable text-driven manipulation, they struggle to provide fine-grained localized control, often entangling features or lacking geometric consistency. Modifying geometry through natural language currently requires slow per-prompt optimization or compromises identity and rigging. We present ManifoldSplat, the first end-toend framework for language-guided semantic shape editing of animatable 3D Gaussian Splatting avatars reconstructed from monocular videos. By performing edits within the structured FLAME manifold rather than directly optimizing an unstructured Gaussian cloud, we strictly preserve identity and animation. We introduce DeltaRegion, a per-region disentangled Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE) delivering feedforward shape deltas, alongside a refining stage to recover view-consistent details. ManifoldSplat reconstructs and edits an avatar in ~90 seconds on a consumer GPU, rendering at ~800 FPS. Extensive evaluations demonstrate our approach sets a new state-of-the-art in localized prompt alignment, geometric coherence, and identity preservation. Project page and code: https://a-canela.github.io/manifoldsplat/
tldr: ManifoldSplat在FLAME流形上实现语言引导的3D高斯头部化身语义形状编辑，保持身份与动画一致性。
motivation: 现有文本驱动头部化身操作方法难以进行细粒度局部控制，易造成特征纠缠与几何不一致；直接修改几何通常依赖缓慢的逐提示优化，或损害身份与绑定。
method: ManifoldSplat是首个面向单目视频重建的可动画3D Gaussian Splatting头像的端到端语言引导语义形状编辑框架；它在结构化FLAME流形内进行编辑而非直接优化非结构化高斯点云，从而严格保持身份与动画。方法还提出按区域解耦的CVAE模块DeltaRegion以前馈方式输出形状增量，并辅以精修阶段恢复视角一致的细节。
result: 在消费级GPU上，ManifoldSplat约90秒完成头像重建与编辑，渲染速度约800 FPS；大量评估表明其在局部提示对齐、几何连贯性和身份保持方面达到新的state-of-the-art。
conclusion: 该工作将语言引导的形状编辑从非结构化高斯优化转移到FLAME流形，实现了快速、局部且身份保持的头部化身编辑；为可动画3DGS头像的语义编辑提供了新范式，并公开项目页面与代码。

title: A Fully Automatic Pipeline for 3D Dendrite Instance Segmentation in SBF-SEM
abstract: Accurate three-dimensional (3D) reconstruction of individual dendrites in serial block-face scanning electron microscopy (SBF-SEM) is essential for quantifying structural plasticity in the brain, yet manual annotation at scale is infeasible. We present a fully automatic pipeline for 3D dendrite instance segmentation that unifies YOLOv6-guided Segment Anything Model (SAM) prompting on downsampled slices, iterative two-dimensional mask refinement, random forest 3D instance linking, and instance-aware high-resolution refinement using nnU-Net at native resolution into a single system requiring no manual prompting at inference. Applied to hippocampal CA1 SBF-SEM datasets from a control rat and a pilocarpine- induced epileptic rat, our pipeline reconstructs coherent, well- separated dendrites with high semantic accuracy (Dice 0.93 and 0.91) and strong instance-level performance on control tissue, while analysis of the more challenging epileptic tissue identifies instance recognition in dense regions as the principal remaining limitation. The high-resolution refinement stage recovers thin dendritic protrusions, providing a basis for downstream spine- level analysis. Code is available at https://github.com/ ZE-WEN/dendrite-3d-instance-seg.
tldr: 提出全自动SBF-SEM三维树突实例分割流水线，结合YOLOv6引导SAM与nnU-Net，无需人工提示。
motivation: 在SBF-SEM中准确重建单根树突对量化脑结构可塑性至关重要，但大规模人工标注不可行。现有方法难以在推理阶段无需人工提示的情况下实现高精度三维实例分割。
method: 该流水线在降采样切片上用YOLOv6引导SAM生成提示，迭代细化二维掩膜，用随机森林进行三维实例连接，并在原分辨率下用nnU-Net进行实例感知高分辨率细化，推理时无需人工提示。
result: 在对照大鼠和匹罗卡品诱导癫痫大鼠海马CA1 SBF-SEM数据上，语义分割Dice分别达0.93和0.91，对照组织实例级性能强，癫痫组织稠密区域实例识别仍是主要限制；高分辨率细化可恢复细树突突起。
conclusion: 该全自动流程可重建连贯且分离良好的树突，为下游树突棘水平分析提供基础，并已开源代码，但稠密区域实例识别仍需改进。

title: HexVIO: Towards All-Day Stereo-Inertial Tracking Through Commodity DSPs
abstract: The ability of a device to localize itself within its surroundings is a fundamental prerequisite for spatial computing. Visual-inertial odometry (VIO) has proven to be a cost-effective and accurate solution for this task. Robots, wearables, XR devices, and drones can benefit significantly from efficient implementations of VIO since they allow for cooler, lighter, and cheaper devices with longer battery life and a better user experience. In this work, we propose to enhance the efficiency of a VIO system by leveraging the Hexagon DSP, a commodity co-processor present in many modern smartphones and XR devices. Our approach offloads the visual frontend of a stereo-inertial odometry system to the DSP while keeping the backend on the main CPU. By optimizing the implementation for the DSP architecture, we achieve significant reductions in power consumption and latency compared to CPU-only execution. Our system, HexVIO, demonstrates a 67% reduction in power consumption or an 86% increase in throughput on a commodity smartphone, with the ability to sustain long-term real-time 30 fps tracking for 0.83 W, corresponding to ~18 hours of tracking on the testing device. These results highlight the potential of commodity DSPs for enabling all-day visual-inertial tracking in robotics and mobile devices.
tldr: HexVIO将双目惯性里程计视觉前端卸载到Hexagon DSP，实现低功耗长时实时跟踪。
motivation: 空间计算设备需要高效自定位，而VIO虽成本低且精度高，但在CPU上运行功耗与延迟较高，限制机器人、可穿戴、XR与无人机的轻量化与长续航。
method: 将双目惯性里程计的视觉前端卸载到现代智能手机和XR设备中常见的Hexagon DSP，后端保留在主CPU，并针对DSP架构优化实现。
result: 在商品智能手机上实现功耗降低67%或吞吐量提升86%，能以0.83W持续30fps实时跟踪约18小时。
conclusion: 结果表明商用DSP可支撑机器人及移动设备全天候视觉惯性跟踪，有助于打造更轻、更便宜且续航更长的空间计算设备。

title: PocketSplat: Mobile Gaussian Reconstruction via World-Space Latent Allocatio
abstract: Mobile Gaussian reconstruction must satisfy two requirements: the reconstruction model must execute within a device resource envelope, and the resulting Gaussian asset must expose a representation size suited to downstream mobile use. Existing feed-forward Gaussian reconstructors commonly decode dense, image-aligned candidates whose final cardinality is implicitly determined by the input resolution and number of views. We present PocketSplat, a feed-forward framework for budgeted mobile Gaussian asset construction. Given a prescribed output budget, PocketSplat organizes dense geometry-aware latent candidates in predicted world space, allocates exact integer capacity across local latent cells, and decodes complete Gaussian attributes only for retained candidates. Cell-conditioned latent fusion aggregates repeated multi-view evidence before decoding, while spatial responsibility decoding adapts Gaussian support after local sparsification. Experiments on DL3DV and out-of-distribution benchmarks establish a strong quality--budget trade-off against feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction baselines. On Mip-NeRF 360, PocketSplat executes directly on a target iPhone and constructs compact, higher-quality Gaussian assets substantially faster than a deployable streamed MVSplat variant; native MVSplat and DepthSplat exceed the device memory budget.
tldr: PocketSplat提出预算化前馈移动高斯重建，在世界空间分配隐变量容量，高效生成紧凑高质量高斯资产。
motivation: 移动端高斯重建需同时满足模型在设备资源约束内运行，以及生成的高斯资产表示大小适合下游移动应用。现有前馈重建器通常解码密集、与图像对齐的候选高斯，其最终数量由输入分辨率和视角数隐式决定，难以按预算控制。
method: 给定输出预算，PocketSplat在预测世界空间中组织密集的几何感知隐变量候选，并在局部隐变量单元上分配精确整数容量，仅对保留候选解码完整高斯属性。其单元条件隐变量融合在解码前聚合多视角证据，空间责任解码则在局部稀疏化后自适应调整高斯支撑。
result: 在DL3DV和分布外基准上，PocketSplat相比前馈高斯重建基线取得了更强的质量-预算权衡。在Mip-NeRF 360上，它可直接在目标iPhone上运行，构建紧凑且质量更高的高斯资产，并显著快于可部署的流式MVSplat变体；原生MVSplat和DepthSplat则超出设备内存预算。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: PocketSplat实现了面向移动端的预算化高斯资产构建，在设备资源约束下兼顾重建质量与资产紧凑性。该工作为移动3D重建、AR/VR等下游应用提供了可部署的前馈高斯重建方案。

title: Budgeted-GS: Real-Time Large-Scale Gaussian Splatting via Factoring LOD
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting achieves excellent visual quality with real-time rendering, but at the scale of entire cities it does not fit: a trained model carries millions of primitives and gigabytes of memory, and real-time rendering at high quality on a consumer GPU remains out of reach. We introduce Budgeted-GS, a post-hoc method that turns any trained 3DGS model into a factoring tree, a multi-resolution hierarchy of moment-matched aggregates. After a construction pass of a few seconds, a single quality parameter selects, for each view, the level of detail that fits the memory of the target device, so the same city-scale model serves GPUs with widely different memory capacities. When a new scene is to be trained, the same theory applies: instead of growing a full-sized model and compressing it afterwards, budget-centered training first measures how many primitives the scene needs and then trains the model directly at that size, avoiding the wasted effort of optimizing primitives that are later discarded. Both methods are grounded in a measurable capacity floor, a budget-error law derived from optimal transport in phase space; selection rules certified by recent covering theorems decide which primitives are redundant. The floor answers how many primitives a scene actually needs and how many can safely be given up. We validate the floor on 13 public scenes under a preregistered protocol, and exercise both methods from object scenes to an official city capture, rendering it at native 1920x1080, full SH, in real time on one consumer GPU.
tldr: Budgeted-GS 通过多分辨率因子树与预算化训练，将大规模 3DGS 压缩到设备内存预算并实现实时渲染。
motivation: 现有 3D Gaussian Splatting 在城市级场景中因数百万基元和数 GB 内存难以在消费级 GPU 上实时高质渲染；需要一种可按设备内存预算自适应、且避免先训练完整模型再压缩造成浪费的方法。
method: 提出后处理 Budgeted-GS，将任意训练好的 3DGS 转为 factoring tree，即对 moment-matched 聚合基元构建多分辨率层级，并用单一质量参数逐视角选择符合目标设备内存的 LOD；同时提出 budget-centered training，先依据相空间最优传输导出的 capacity floor 与 budget-error law 估计场景所需基元数并直接按预算训练，覆盖定理认证冗余选择规则。
result: 在 13 个公开场景上按预注册协议验证容量下界，并从物体级场景到官方城市采集验证两类方法；在单张消费级 GPU 上以原生 1920×1080、完整 SH 实现实时城市级渲染。
conclusion: 该方法将模型容量、LOD 选择与训练规模统一到可度量的预算框架，使同一城市级 3DGS 模型可适配不同显存 GPU，并为大规模实时神经渲染提供理论基础与实用路径。

title: RYOPO: Bringing End-to-End Category-Level Object Pose Estimation into Real Time
abstract: Category-level object pose estimation predicts the rotation, translation, and metric size of unseen instances within known categories. Many accurate RGB-D methods rely on external instance segmentation and crop-based pose estimation, introducing separate stages and object-dependent processing costs that hinder real-time inference. To bring accurate pose estimation into real time, we present \ours{}, an end-to-end trainable query-based RGB-D set predictor. It jointly detects and segments objects and estimates their \mbox{9-DoF} poses without explicit CAD-derived shape priors or a separately trained instance segmentor. Shared image and scene encoding avoids repeated per-object crop encoding. A query-conditioned geometry pathway associates observed 3D points and RGB features with object queries and incorporates shared scene context. Object-centric refinement uses the resulting point descriptors to update an explicit pose state through pose-conditioned cross-attention and recurrent residual corrections. On NOCS, \ours{} substantially improves on published RGB-D joint detection and pose estimation results. It achieves competitive performance compared with two-stage methods under all-object evaluation on REAL275 and HouseCat6D, while enabling real-time full-frame pose estimation at $31.8$ FPS on an RTX~A6000. Project page: https://yopo-series.github.io/RYOPO-project-page/.
tldr: RYOPO 提出端到端查询式 RGB-D 集合预测器，实现实时类别级物体位姿估计。
motivation: 现有高精度 RGB-D 类别级位姿估计方法多依赖外部实例分割与逐对象裁剪处理，流程分阶段且计算量随物体数量增加，难以实时推理。本文旨在不依赖 CAD 形状先验和独立实例分割器的前提下，实现准确、端到端的实时位姿估计。
method: RYOPO 是可端到端训练的查询式 RGB-D 集合预测器，联合完成物体检测、分割与 9-DoF 位姿估计，省去 CAD 形状先验和独立实例分割器。方法共享图像与场景编码以避免逐对象重复裁剪编码，并通过查询条件几何通路将 3D 点与 RGB 特征关联到物体查询；再以物体为中心的细化模块，利用点描述子经位姿条件交叉注意力和循环残差校正更新显式位姿状态。
result: 在 NOCS 上，RYOPO 显著优于已发表的 RGB-D 联合检测与位姿估计结果；在 REAL275 和 HouseCat6D 的全部物体评估协议下，与两阶段方法相比具有竞争力。在 RTX A6000 上，全帧位姿估计达到 31.8 FPS 的实时速度。
conclusion: 结果表明，端到端查询式 RGB-D 预测可在不依赖外部分割与形状先验的情况下兼顾精度与实时性，为类别级物体位姿估计的实时部署提供了新方案。该工作将类别级物体位姿估计推进到实时端到端范式，主要贡献是联合检测、分割与 9-DoF 位姿的共享编码及查询式几何细化框架。其潜在影响是降低多阶段流水线开销，推动机器人与 AR/VR 等实时应用。

title: Kinematics-Induced Multimodal 3D Human Pose Estimation with Subject-Level Privacy
abstract: Multimodal 3D Human Pose Estimation (3D HPE) combines complementary information from RGB, LiDAR, and mmWave radar, but models trained on correlated observations from the same individuals, raise privacy risks overlooked by record level analysis. We present a unified framework for multimodal 3D HPE that couples kinematics-induced sensor fusion with subject level privacy auditing and private training. First, our multimodal model aligns modality specific joint representation, injects skeletal structure and adaptively aggregates complementary sensor evidence for accurate pose prediction. Second, we formulate a black-box subject membership inference attack for 3D HPE, complemented by an empirical pointwise maximal leakage analysis, which characterizes how individual attack score outcomes change inference about the membership outcome. Third, we instantiate user-level differential privacy via Action Temporal Stratification, a population weighted within-subject sampling strategy that enforces action and temporal coverage. We evaluate our framework on the MM-Fi dataset across three diverse experimental protocols. Source-code will be released upon acceptance.
tldr: 提出融合运动学多模态融合与受试者级隐私审计及私有训练的人体3D姿态估计框架。
motivation: 多模态3D人体姿态估计可融合RGB、LiDAR与毫米波雷达的互补信息，但基于同一受试者相关观测训练会带来记录级分析忽略的隐私风险，需要受试者级隐私审计与保护。
method: 提出统一框架：多模态模型对齐模态特定关节表示，注入骨骼结构并自适应聚合传感器证据以预测姿态；构建面向3D HPE的黑盒受试者成员推断攻击与逐点最大泄漏经验分析；通过Action Temporal Stratification实现用户级差分隐私，并采用总体加权受试者内采样保证动作与时间覆盖。
result: 在MM-Fi数据集上使用三种不同实验协议进行评估；摘要未提供具体量化指标，仅说明源代码将在录用后公开。
conclusion: 该工作将运动学诱导的多模态融合、受试者级隐私审计与用户级差分隐私训练统一起来，为多模态3D人体姿态估计提供了兼顾精度与隐私保护的研究方向。
